review.shorterRoute: Reuse the existing finite-factor Chebotarev theorem and actual norm-residue Frobenius lift to compare the determinant and cyclotomic characters. review.assumptionsToDischarge: Global determinant compatibility is proved from the exact original good-prime Frobenius determinant.
